2609.25397.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
2609.25397.paper_summary: The one-dimensional bin packing problem (1D-BPP) is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications ranging from logistics and manufacturing to cloud resource management. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has become a competitive paradigm for data-driven optimization, most learned packing methods target 2D and 3D variants, and intelligent learned solvers for 1D-BPP remain scarce. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP. We formulate the packing process as a Markov decision process on an item-compatibility graph, serving as a structural knowledge representation in which every action merges two partial bins that fit together. A graph neural network actor-critic policy extracts relational features from this representation and is trained through reinforcement learning and decoded by stochastic beam search, enabling a single trained model to generalize zero-shot to instances of any size. We conduct a systematic empirical study across graph encoders, DRL algorithms, reward functions, training distributions, and hyperparameters. Evaluated zero-shot on the full BPPLIB benchmark against a constructive heuristic, a grouping genetic algorithm, and recent learned methods, our data-driven policy lowers the mean optimality gap of the constructive heuristic from 2.66\% to 2.31\%, with the largest gains on structured instances. Against learned baselines evaluated on the same benchmark, it attains a lower gap on most of the nine families and is far more stable across instance distributions. On the hardest benchmark family, it outperforms a state-of-the-art learned solver that relies on column generation and integer programming, while using no solver at all. A grouping genetic algorithm remains ahead overall, and we analyze where and why the residual gap arises.
2609.25397.paper_summary_zh: 一維裝箱問題（1D-BPP）是一個經典的 NP-hard 組合優化問題，應用範圍從物流和製造到雲資源管理。雖然深度強化學習（DRL）已成為數據驅動優化的競爭性範式，但大多數學習的裝箱方法針對的是 2D 和 3D 變體，而針對 1D-BPP 的智能學習解算器仍然稀缺。在本文中，我們提出了一種新穎的端到端、大小無關的圖形強化學習框架，用於 1D-BPP。我們將裝箱過程表述為一個項目兼容性圖上的馬爾可夫決策過程，作為一種結構知識表示，其中每個行動合併兩個相容的部分箱。圖神經網絡的演員-評論者策略從這一表示中提取關係特徵，並通過強化學習進行訓練，通過隨機束搜索進行解碼，使得單個訓練模型能夠對任何大小的實例進行零樣本泛化。我們對圖編碼器、DRL 算法、獎勵函數、訓練分佈和超參數進行了系統的實證研究。在對完整的 BPPLIB 基準進行零樣本評估時，與一個建構性啟發式、一個分組遺傳算法和最近的學習方法相比，我們的數據驅動策略將建構性啟發式的平均最優性差距從 2.66\% 降低到 2.31\%，在結構化實例上獲得了最大的增益。在與在同一基準上評估的學習基準相比時，它在大多數九個家族中達到了更低的差距，並且在實例分佈上更加穩定。在最困難的基準家族中，它的表現超過了一個依賴於列生成和整數規劃的最先進學習解算器，而完全不使用任何解算器。分組遺傳算法在整體上仍然領先，我們分析了殘差差距出現的原因和位置。
